content: Jerusalén-neggwebur-bendaklesad
Rey-Ezequías deyob ibmar-itosgua, e-mor-yoid siir-siir imaksad. Geb wile-itoged-mor yosad. Geb Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse naded.

Degi geb Rey-Ezequías, dummad-reyneg-dakdiid-Eliaquim, degi, ibmar-gusad-narmaked-Sebna, degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-sergan wile-itoged-mor-yoyoi, Amoz-machi-Isaías-daknamalaga barmisad. Isaíasʼde, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedid.

Isaíasʼga sognonimalad: “Weyob Rey-Ezequías soged: ‘Emi-iba-naidi, suli-suli-itoged-iba naid, sabsur-odurdakleged-iba naid, degine, bingegued-dummad-iba naid. Igi ome muu-neggi-nagudele, na abagan-nollo-naddae, deyob emi-iba naid.

” ’Bitigine, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, Asiria-sordamar-e-dummad-ibmar-sogsadi, bela itosana gadin. Ar ade, Asiria-e-rey, e-sorda-dummad, Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maidgi-dodoar-sunmakega barmiar gusad. ” ’Bitigine, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, we-dule-gayaburba-itosadba sabsur-odurdaksunnana gadin. Bab-Dummadse Israel-dulemar-napi-gudimaladga be gorsun.’ ”
Rey-Ezequías-e-dummagan Isaíasʼse nadmargu,
Isaías ega sokalid: “Weyob be-dummadga be sogmalo: ‘Bab-Jehová weyob sogye: Be we-dule-ibmar-soge-itosadgine, Asiria-e-rey-e-dummagan angi ise-yolegar-sunmaksadgine, mer be gwayo.
¡Be dako! Senaquerib gayaburba-isgana-itogega an imakoed. Geb gannar e-yarse naoed. Geb e-yargi, es-suidgi oburgwemalaga an imakoed.’ ”
Asiria-sordamar-e-dummadi, Asiria-e-rey, Laquis-neggweburgi-mai-nadye-wisguargu, balimakde gusad. Libna-neggwebur-ebo bila-ononai Asiria-e-rey-dakdapid.
Geb agine, Rey-Senaquerib wisgualid, Etiopía-dulemar-e-rey-Tirhaca, ebo bila-onogega egi daniye. Deyob-wisguargua, gannar Rey-Ezequíasʼse dule-gayaburba-berbemalad barmisad,
ega sogegar: “Judá-e-rey-Ezequías, be-Bab-Dummad-egi-be-bensurgudiid bega-sogedi: ‘Asiria-e-rey Jerusalén-neggwebur suosurye.’ Mer be-Bab-Jehováʼse be yardaklego.
Ar Asiria-e-rey bela yarmar-obelos-gusadde be wisgussursi. Ar degite be, ¿san-onogo be itoge?

Ar an-babgan Gozán-neggwebur-obelosgusadi, Harán-neggwebur-obelosgusadi, Resef-neggwebur-obelosgusadi, Edén-wagan-Telasar-neggweburgi-bukwad-obelosgusbalidi, degitega, ¿e-bab-dummagan bendaksa be daksi?
Degite, ¿bia Hamat-dulemar-e-reyde, Arfad-dulemar-e-reyde, nadmarsunna? ¿Bia Sefarvaim-dulemar-e-reyde, Hena-dulemar-e-reyde, Iva-dulemar-e-reyde, nadmarsunna?”
Ezequías Bab-Dummadse-gochad
Degine, Rey-Ezequías, dule-gayaburba-berbemalad-abin garda susad, geb absosad. Geb a-sorbali, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse naded. Geb Bab-Jehová-asabin garda nallaa imaksad.
Geb degi, Ezequías weyopira Bab-Jehováʼse goted:

“Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nika-Maid, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad, baliwiturmar-wagar-darbakegwad-abargi be negsemaid. Unnila bebi we-napneg-naid-e-Bab-Dummadga be gued. Be nibnega nasiksad, napnega be obinnisbalid.
Bab-Jehová-Dula-Maidye, nue be an-itoye, nue be anmar-gunaid be dakye. Igi Senaquerib begi ise-yolegar anga gayaburba-barmiali, nue be itoge.
”Bab-Jehová, ar nue napiragwa, Asiria-e-reymar we-neggweburmar, e-yarmar, obelosad.
E-bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad bela soogi-ogumaksabalid. Ar wemar Bab-Dummadsurmalad, suarmar-sobaled nanaed, akwa-sobarmalad nanaed. Dulemar sobsananaedid.
Emidi, Bab-Jehová, be-anmar-Bab-Dummadid, wis be we-dulegi anmar-bendake, adi, dulemar bela we-napneggi-bukmalad be-wisgumalaga, unnila beebi, Bab-Jehová wargwenna maiye.”
Rey-Senaquerib-burgwisad
Geb degi, Amoz-machi-Isaías, Rey-Ezequíasʼse weyob gayaburba barmisad: “Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad, weyob soged: ‘Be anga Asiria-e-rey-Senaqueribʼgi ibmar-sogsadi, bela an be-itosye.
Ani an Bab-Jehová, weyob Rey-Senaqueribʼnik an soged:

content.text: Senaquerib, Siónʼginmalad sae be-dakmalad, begi dodomalad.
Ar be Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Isligwalednik be isdar sunmaksad.
Weyob be sogsad: An-moli-ur-bila-onomaladgi Líbano-yar-dummagan-birigi an nakwisye.
E-urwarmar-dummagan-bubukwad, ani an ei siksa naiye.
Ar bato an dikasurgus we-ibmarmar-guoed an ega igar mesisad.
Bato yola-birgabargus weyob-imakega an igar amisad.
Aga be nabir neggwebur-sakdigar-bukmalad be obelos nanaed.
” ’An nue bela-belad be-wisid, sanase be signonidae,
mer bar be sunmakega be-gaya an edinnoed.
Degine, bia be danigusa, gannar a-igarba an be-barmidoed.’ ”

content: Isaías, Rey-Ezequíasʼga weyob soged:

content.text: Geb birgapaasedina, sunna ibmar-gwaggi be arbamaloed,
degi, geb nabir e-san be gunmaloed.
Ar Jerusalén-neggweburgi wis ichee dulemar bedapoed,

content: Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová, Asiria-e-reynik weyob soged:

content.text: We-dule, bila-onogega we-neggweburse sigu-abgaedyalaba gwen urwosulid.
we-neggwebur an bendakoed, we-neggwebur an obelogosulid.”

content: A-mutikidgine, Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur, Asiria-sorda-bukwadgine, mili-dulabakebak-gakatar (185,000) dulemar-ogilosad. Degine, neg-oiboargu, bela dulemar burgwar-mamaitibi oiboalid.
Degidgine, geb Asiria-rey-Senaquerib nadegusad, gannar Nínive-neggweburse nonigusad, agine megidapid.

Ibagwengi, Rey-Senaquerib bab-dummad-Nisrocʼse-goled-neggi, e-bab-dummadse-gorsiidgi, e-masmala Adramelec, degi, Sarezer, es-suidgi Senaquerib-oburgwismalad. Geb agine, Ararat-yalase wakitegusmalad. Senaquerib-sorbali, e-machi-Esar-Hadón yar-sesad.
